Welcome to ​Three Sisters Farm

Three Sisters Farm specializes in all things wholesome from the pasture, garden, dairy barn and chicken coop.  We love sharing our produce, eggs, and meat products and we are passionate about teaching people more about the food they eat.

​

Whether you enjoy farm fresh eggs, want fresh produce that you pick yourself, or are interested in learning to make your own cheese or preserves, Three Sisters Farm & Dairy can give you an experience to remember and the high-quality products your family deserves.

Pasture Raised Beef

​Three Sisters cattle grow under the warm southeastern Colorado sunshine eating their natural diet of Grass and Hay.   They are hormone free and antibiotics are only used on an as-needed basis.  As when a person gets sick they may require medicine, so do animals.  Providing an animal with the medical treatment he needs to thrive is called Good Animal Husbandry.  If they aren’t sick, we don’t medicate.

​

Each Fall and Spring we offer cattle for sale at on-the-hoof Market Price.  Animals are able to be processed at a number of local butcher shops which we will be happy to recommend.  

FAQ about our Beef
Is grass fed beef tender?

There are many factors that affect meat tenderness, including genetics, age, nutrition, quality grade, and preparation technique. 

What is natural beef?

Natural beef is defined by the USDA as beef that is minimally processed, with no artificial ingredients. 

What does "antibiotic-free" mean?

The USDA requires that meat and poultry be labeled "no antibiotics added" if documents prove that the animals were raised without the drugs from birth til slaughter. However, this isn't always the case, and some products labeled "raised without antibiotics" have been found to contain the drugs.

Our motivation

Three Sisters Farm & Dairy started out of the love we have for our animals and raising food in a sustainable way in hopes of preserving this Farm and lifestyle for our Family for future generations.

We love what we do and want to share this love of animals and farming with others, especially children.  As funny as it sounds to some of us that know where our food chain starts, there are those who think food “just comes from a store”.  We need to educate our families about how our food is grown and raised and the amount of time, energy and dedication it requires from our country’s farmers and ranchers.  Instead of tuning out and distancing ourselves from those who don’t know or share our lifestyle, I believe we should share what we know and educate them.

Our Future

Over the next few years, we hope to see Three Sisters Farm and Dairy evolve into a Store Front Artisan Creamery that will be able to create a monthly Farm to Table Menu based on the foods grown and raised locally to share with those in and around our Community.
